Premature leaf drying
symptoms_sd: پنن تي نارنگي يا ناسي ڦٽ
causes: Rust fungus spread by wind
causes_sd: هوا سان پکڙجندڙ رتيءَ واري ڦڦوند
prevention: Avoid late sowing where rust is common
prevention_sd: رتيءَ واري بيماري وارن علائقن ۾ دير سان پوک کان بچو
treatment: Use recommended triazole fungicide at early infection
treatment_sd: شروعاتي بيماري تي سفارش ڪيل ٽرائيازول ڦڦوند مار دوا استعمال ڪريو
visual_confusion_risks: Early-stage symptoms may be hard to detect from one image
Poor lighting, dust, or blur can reduce model confidence
Can be confused with nutrient deficiency or old mechanical damage
diseases.economic_threshold_action: Treat if more than 10% leaves or new flush show active symptoms, or if disease is spreading after rain.

early: Scout field and confirm symptoms on multiple plants
Remove visibly infected leaves or plant debris where practical
moderate: Apply IPM measures and use recommended treatment only if symptoms are spreading
Improve airflow, irrigation timing, and field sanitation
severe: Isolate or remove heavily infected plant material
Use recommended chemical control with PPE and local agriculture advice

diseases.resistance_notes: Repeated use of the same fungicide group may select resistant pathogen populations. Rotate modes of action and avoid unnecessary sprays.
progression_stages: Stage 1: small spots or mild discoloration
Stage 2: lesion expansion and visible tissue damage
Stage 3: tissue necrosis, leaf drop, or fruit/flower damage
diseases.recommendation_summary: Remove infected leaves/debris immediately and consider Propiconazole within 48 hours if symptoms are active and spreading.

diseases.label: Cotton Leaf Curl
differential_diagnosis: Herbicide injury may curl leaves but lacks vein thickening
Nutrient stress usually does not create enations
organic_treatment_options: Manage whitefly with yellow sticky traps and conservation of natural enemies
diseases.chemical_safety_warning: Virus has no curative spray. Avoid repeated pesticide use; target whitefly only when monitoring shows need.
diseases.name: Cotton Leaf Curl
symptoms: Leaves curl upward or downward
Vein thickening
Stunted plants
causes: Virus transmitted by whitefly
prevention_sd: سفيد مک کي جلد قابو ڪريو
treatment: No cure for infected plants; manage whitefly and crop hygiene
treatment_sd: بيمار ٻوٽي جو علاج ناهي؛ سفيد مک ۽ صفائي تي ڌيان ڏيو

favorable_conditions.rainfall: Dry warm periods can increase whitefly pressure

visual_confusion_risks: Early-stage symptoms may be hard to detect from one image
Poor lighting, dust, or blur can reduce model confidence
Can be confused with herbicide injury or nutrient stress
diseases.economic_threshold_action: Remove infected plants and manage whitefly if symptoms appear on more than 2-3% plants or whitefly exceeds local threshold.

early: Remove infected volunteer plants
Start whitefly monitoring with sticky traps
moderate: Manage whitefly using IPM and tolerant varieties
Remove heavily infected young plants if spread is increasing
severe: Do not rely on curative spray; rogue badly infected plants
Control vector pressure and avoid planting near infected fields

diseases.resistance_notes: No curative pesticide exists for viral infection. Resistance management should focus on tolerant varieties and vector control.
progression_stages: Stage 1: slight leaf curling or vein changes
Stage 2: clear vein thickening and plant stunting
Stage 3: severe stunting and yield loss
diseases.recommendation_summary: Do not use curative spray. Remove badly infected plants where needed and control whitefly with IPM monitoring within 3 days.
